$schema_note: Curated initial destination dataset for Wanderes's MVP, approved by the user on 2026-08-29. Not yet loaded into a Django model - the Destination model itself is a Phase 4 (Joint Review) deliverable per PROJECT_STATE.md. This file is the source of truth to seed that model once it exists. Weather/climate data at request time comes from the Open-Meteo integration (Phase 3 decision), not from the 'best_season'/'worst_season' fields here, which are general descriptive guidance only. Translated from the original Portuguese to English (canonical source language) on 2026-09-06 - see DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md for why.
